_note: USD per search for the direct arms, used only to ESTIMATE direct-vendor search cost in analyze.py. List prices as published on the vendors' pricing pages; each includes up to 10 results per request, which covers the harness's 8. Jevlin arms are never priced from this file; the gateway reports what each search cost.

_sources.exa_fast: https://exa.ai/pricing — Search API, Fast/Auto: $7 per 1k requests (Instant $4, Deep $12)
_sources.parallel_fast: https://parallel.ai/pricing — Search API, Fast: $1 per 1k requests with 10 results (Basic/Advanced $5)
_sources.perplexity_low: https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/pricing — Search API: $5 per 1k requests (Fast Search $1); the harness calls /search, the standard Search API
